## Visualisation dudalling

```{r load}
library(igraph)
g <- make_graph("Zachary")
plot(g)
```

## EDA
### Node charactersists

```{r EDA node charactersists}
gmat <- as_adjacency_matrix(g, type = "both", sparse = FALSE)
print(gmat)

# directed?
isSymmetric.matrix(gmat)

# Size
# number of nodes
vcount(g)
# number of edges
ecount(g)

# degree distribution
igraph::degree(g)
hist(table(degree(g)), xlab='in-degree', main= 'Histogram of in-degree')

# alle mogelijke trihoekjes
igraph::transitivity(g, type = c("localundirected"), isolates = c("NaN", "zero"))

# betweenness
igraph::betweenness(g, directed = FALSE, normalized = T)

V(g)$size <- igraph::betweenness(g, directed = FALSE, normalized = T) * 100 + 10
V(g)$color <- igraph::betweenness(g, directed = FALSE, normalized = T) * 100
plot(g)

# met u-palette kleur geven aan betweenness
```
# Edge characteristics

```{r edges}
igraph::dyad_census(g)

igraph::triad_census(g)

# I will use sna because it shows the names of the triads as well.
sna::triad.census(gmat)
unloadNamespace("sna")  

plot(c(0, 1, 2, 3), c(3971, 1575, 393, 300))
#I will detach this package again, otherwise it will interfere with all kind of functions from igraph, and my students will hate me for that.


igraph::transitivity(g, type = "global")
sna::gtrans(gmat)

triad_g <- data.frame(sna::triad.census(gmat))


transitivity_g <- (3 * triad_g$X300)/(triad_g$X201 + 3 * triad_g$X300)
transitivity_g



```

```{r layout}
set.seed(2345)
l <- layout_with_dh(g)  #https://igraph.org/r/doc/layout_with_mds.html
plot(g, layout = l)

l  #let us take a look at the coordinates
l[1, 1] <- 4
l[34, 1] <- -3.5
plot(g, layout = l)


```
